1. The above results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September, 2025 were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 29 October, 2025.

2. The Company has only one reportable segment as per the requirements of Ind AS 108 "Operating Segments".

3. During the quarter ended 30 June, 2025, on account of change in the operational plans and for functional efficiency, the Company has transferred the leasing rights and a building constructed therein at Sandila Unit after obtaining due approvals from the Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Authority (UPSIDA) and the resultant gain of Rs.82.10 Lakhs is disclosed as an exceptional item.

4. This statement is as per Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
